text:
morgan: follow-up to the model-versioning thread: i want a compact 'label hint' payload that clients can fetch cheaply and use to bias version selection. NOT a replacement for pins.
sam: +1. compact how? small field set?
morgan: exactly. minimal fields: labels (ordered list), priority (int), intent (enum: prefer|require-soft-fallback|ignore), scope (public|internal|restricted), issued_at (ISO8601), source (ops|auto|client), ttl_seconds (optional). keep size < 1KB.
carla: why "priority" not "precedence"?
morgan: shorter name. semantics: higher value => more weight in ordering. explicitly documented as ordering-only.
devin: important: never let priority bypass compatibility. routers must check compatibility mask before honoring a label. add that to the client contract.
morgan: yep. also propose server-side config sane_backwindow_seconds to prevent old-but-high-priority hints from stomping newer ones.
sam: can we allow multiple labels on one rollout? e.g., stable + perf-check. clients might prefer stable but accept perf-check if stable incompatible.
carla: yes. ordered list where first is primary. client_hint/intent + list order guide client coordinator.
devin: tie-breaker: sort by priority desc, then issued_at desc. if priority conflicts with recency beyond sane_backwindow, emit metric label_priority_conflict and prefer newer.
morgan: example payload (single-line transport form, values as strings): 
{"labels":"stable-2026-03,canary-7","priority":"9","intent":"prefer","scope":"public","issued_at":"2026-03-21T17:00:00Z","source":"ops","ttl_seconds":"3600"}
carla: note: transport uses simple CSV for labels to keep size down; docs will show JSON-list variant for richer clients.
sam: router pseudocode sketch: 
# fetch manifests and label-hints for candidates
candidates = gather_versions()
candidates = sort(candidates, key=(v.priority, v.issued_at), reverse=True)
for v in candidates:
  if is_schema_compatible(v):
    if client_prefers(v) or v.intent == 'prefer':
      return v
# fallback to deterministic resolver (content-hash/semantic)

devin: add explicit note: intent == 'require-soft-fallback' means client should avoid lower-priority choices unless compatibility forces it. still not a hard lock.
morgan: telemetry: label_hint_applied (model, labels, source, scope), label_hint_conflict (model, labels, detected_backdate), label_hint_flip. include priority & issued_at in events.
carla: tests: unit for CSV label parsing, priority vs issued_at ties, scope filtering (internal vs public), ttl expiry. e2e: simulate coordinator making choices under load.
sam: SLOs: ensure decision loop adds <1ms overhead on hot path. bench with 100 candidate versions scenario.
morgan: action items: @carla update docs with payload examples and CSV note, @sam add unit + e2e tests and perf bench, @devin add sane_backwindow enforcement and telemetry spots, @morgan update RFC doc.
ops-bot: deploybot: rollout created by @carla model=opt-4o labels=[stable-2026-03,perf-smoke] priority=8 intent=prefer scope=public ttl_seconds=7200
morgan: thanks. quick follow-up: add a short "do not use for locks" blurb at the top of the docs to avoid accidental enforcement.
sam: will add tests for accidental-enforcement scenarios. :+1:
